source: Real Tab focus, computed-style capture, rendered screenshot, and contrast measurement on the Olivero mobile local-tabs trigger
wcag_or_apg: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color and SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast
evidence: EVID-FULL-SUITE-RESOLUTIONS: five real Tab presses reached the visible .tabs__trigger at a 320 by 568 CSS pixel viewport.
The existing 1 CSS pixel border changed from rgb(234, 238, 240) to rgb(27, 154, 228); no outline or shadow appeared.
The focused border measured 2.902:1 against the adjacent rgb(246, 248, 248) background, below 3:1.
reproduction_steps: Open /user/login with Olivero active and set the viewport below the local-tabs breakpoint.
Press Tab until focus reaches the Tabs display toggle.
Compare the focused and unfocused trigger and measure the focused border against its adjacent background.
expected_behavior: Keyboard focus has a non-color cue or a color change with sufficient luminance contrast, and the visual focus indicator reaches at least 3:1 against adjacent colors.
actual_behavior: Focus changes only the color of the existing 1 CSS pixel border, and the focused border measures 2.902:1 against the adjacent background.
